categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/walletdb.cpp to defer transaction chain state updates to AttachChain.
categories.rationale: Fixes a wallet state desynchronization bug that triggers node crashes via assertion failures and leaves confirmed transactions eligible for incorrect abandonment. The problem statement notes that missing blocks between wallet stored best block and chain tip during loading causes 'assertion failures such as !wtx.isConfirmed() and allowing confirmed transactions to be incorrectly eligible for abandonment'.
